auditCategory: Light / Dark Theme Readability & WCAG Compliance

primaryRootCause.issue: In Tailwind v4, @import "tailwindcss" maps dark: variant to @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) by default. The application manages theme state via an HTML class (.dark on <html>). Missing @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); caused OS-level dark mode to forcefully apply dark: classes even when users toggled to Light Mode.
primaryRootCause.impact: Light mode displayed dark-mode styles in dark-mode OS environments, producing low-contrast or inverted color collisions.
primaryRootCause.resolution: Added @custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *)); directly after @import "tailwindcss" in src/app/globals.css.

secondaryRootCause.issue: Low-contrast token usage: text-slate-400 (#94a3b8) on white (#ffffff) has a 2.3:1 contrast ratio, failing WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum.
secondaryRootCause.impact: Product codes, table subtitles, search input placeholder, footer text, and category headers were washed out in light mode.
secondaryRootCause.resolution: Elevated light-mode text tokens to text-slate-600 (#475569, 7.0:1) and text-slate-700 (#334155, 9.5:1), and placeholder to text-slate-400 / text-slate-500.
